metric.why: Five nines, 99.999 percent, allows about five minutes of downtime a year; four nines allows about fifty-two. The gap between marketing nines and contracted, measured, penalty-backed nines is where disputes live.
metric.target: Uptime Institute's tier system (I through IV) is the common design-redundancy vocabulary behind these commitments.
metric.definition: Delivered availability measured against the contracted service level, conventionally quoted in nines.
